tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is 24.6, while the pilot covers only H ≤ 0.48. The slow-horizon probe directly tests and calibrates the predicted endogenous reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-exponential model to pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify the slow adaptation governing the target horizon.
Additional short-time detail would not directly resolve the long-horizon reversal.
The pilot has no s_grad variation, leaving sink coupling unidentified.
